model_annotation: The figure contains two side-by-side line plots illustrating how BLEU varies as a function of two different parameters, α (left) and p (right). In the left plot, the x-axis is labeled “α” on a linear scale with values shown at 0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, and 0.9, and the y-axis is labeled “BLEU” on a linear scale spanning roughly 28.0 to 28.5 with tick labels at 0.1 intervals. A single blue solid line with circular markers increases from about 28.0 at α=0.1 to about 28.33 at α=0.3 and peaks near 28.53 at α=0.5, then decreases to about 28.40 at α=0.7 and about 28.12 at α=0.9. In the right plot, the x-axis is labeled “p” on a linear scale with values shown at 0.05, 0.15, 0.25, 0.35, and 0.45, and the y-axis is also labeled “BLEU” with the same approximate range and 0.1 tick interval. A single blue solid line with circular markers rises from about 28.31 at p=0.05 to about 28.53 at p=0.15, drops to about 28.42 at p=0.25, rises to about 28.47 at p=0.35, and then slightly decreases to about 28.43 at p=0.45.
